title: Look up a single Twitter/X tweet by its numeric tweet ID. Returns full tweet dat
description: Look up a single Twitter/X tweet by its numeric tweet ID. Returns full tweet data including text, author profile, creation date, engagement metrics (likes, retweets, replies, quotes, bookmarks), and referenced tweets. Query param: id (string, required) - numeric tweet ID, e.g. GET /tweets/by/id?id=1110302988. Returns X v2 API-compatible JSON.

_signals.x_guidance: This API requires MPP payment via Tempo for each request. Costs range from $0.0025 to $0.01 USDC per call. To use: (1) send a probe request to get a 402 challenge, (2) pay via Tempo using an MPP client such as mppx, (3) retry with the payment credential in the Authorization header. No gas required — server sponsors all Tempo gas fees.
